1.why: Clean sans-serif typeface is used throughout with generous letter and line spacing on every screen.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case, no italics or all-caps, and appear as short separated lines rather than dense blocks.

3.why: Layouts are single-column cards with large tap targets and readable text that fit mobile viewport widths without crowding.

4.why: All instructional copy is brief and plain, e.g. 'Enter the practice code shown in this browser' and 'There is no rush'.

5.why: Examples are shown repeatedly: 'like 123456', placeholder '123456', practice codes displayed, and backup-code format 'ABCD-EFGH-IJKL'.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long paragraph; content is limited to one or two short sentences plus a single primary action.

7.why: Copy buttons are provided for the setup key ('Copy setup key') and for all backup codes ('Copy all codes').

8.why: A QR code is prominently offered on the authenticator setup screen as the primary alternative to manual key entry.

9.why: Standard email and password fields support browser autofill and password managers, though OTP fields use generic text inputs without explicit one-time-code autocomplete attributes visible.

10.why: Step indicator ('Step X of 5'), clear headings, and a single large blue primary button make the current step and action obvious on every screen.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one main task and one primary button (Continue, Send my code, Check code, I added it to my app, etc.).

12.why: Feedback is explicit after actions, e.g. green 'Setup complete.' banner and the final 'MFA is ready' confirmation of what happened and that enrolment finished.

13.why: Users can resend codes, get new practice codes, show/hide the setup key, and re-display backup codes, with explicit 'Retries have no penalty' messaging.

14.why: Error text states the problem and fix without blame: 'We could not sign you in. Check your email and password, then try again.'

15.why: Copy repeatedly states there is no rush and no time limit for reading or retries, and no countdown timers appear on any screen.
